title: Replay existing human feedback with transition-triggered rubric optimization
description: Run fresh operational replay of frozen 87-label snapshot with every-second class-change rubric trigger. Preserve prior recording and source votes. Explicit ceilings: 6000 decision requests and 11 optimizer calls. Verify rubric call cycles, payloads, active question/example evolution and prequential per-class metrics; refresh served explorer only with the new trace. Existing example/question promotion policies remain unchanged so this evaluates the new rubric schedule.

comments.author: home
comments.text: First live replay v1 stopped at cycle 6 after optimizer explicitly declined to infer a rubric from one eligible Exclude example. Implemented nonfatal recorded no-change handling for blank proposals; active rubric is never cleared. Regression spec failed before fix; full suite now 512 passes. Fresh replay v2 is running within original per-run ceilings, with rubric requests already at cycles 6 and 15. User additionally authorized continuing low-cost experiments. Preserve v1 failure trace and report its 6 decision / 1 optimizer calls separately.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Completed v2: 87 cycles, 370 decision requests, 11 optimizer requests. Seven rubric calls at cycles 6,15,22,25,33,41,61. Actual request audit: six examples from cycle 40; five classifications from cycle 60; seven examples from cycle 80; nonempty rubric after cycle 6. Prequential agreement 77/87 (88.5%), Include recall 4/8 (50%), precision 4/10 (40%), balanced accuracy 71.2%. Majority accuracy baseline 79/87 is higher but has zero Include recall. Not final-model held-out accuracy or a controlled causal comparison. Refreshed served explorer, browser verified late decision exposes expanded request. Failed v1 preserved (6 decision,1 optimizer call). Added safe no-change lifecycle handling and regression specs; full Python suite 513 passes. Added text-free aggregate README notes.
